body.name: Support-valid guarded formula
body.construction: A finite family \(F=(F_S:S\subseteq\prod_{i\in V}\Omega_i)\) in which each \(F_S\) is an observed-cell expression formed by finite sums, products, and ratios, and every denominator used by \(F_S\) is certified positive by the guard \(\operatorname{supp}(P_M(V))=S\); evaluation returns \(F_{\operatorname{supp}(P_M(V))}(P_M(V))\).
